headline: Consideration of $200,000 from district fund balance toward 767-771 Lonsdale Ave. project, and a general contractor contract for new PK-8 Dual Language building.
summary: The meeting will cover a $200,000 appropriation for a Lonsdale Avenue project and a general contractor contract for a new PK-8 Dual Language building. It also includes a carpentry training program, a school resource officer contract, a University Orthopedic contract, and a first reading of an artificial intelligence policy.
